edge_cases: Rendering a template with a malformed TAL expression triggers an ExpressionError.
Templates containing Unicode characters are rendered and compared using UTF‑8 decoding.
Boolean HTML attributes are omitted or rendered empty based on truthiness of the value.
Path expressions that resolve to nothing or have alternatives are handled gracefully.
Switch and default keyword handling in TAL expressions are exercised.
Templates that include XML headers, empty replacements, or interpolation in content are verified.
contract.intent: Run a suite of unit tests that verify Zope PageTemplate rendering (using the Chameleon engine) against expected HTML output for a variety of template features and edge cases.
invariants: Each test restores the original security policy and component registrations on teardown.
Template objects are isolated per test; state does not leak between tests.
The provided utility functions (read_input, read_output, check_html) are assumed to behave deterministically.
All template rendering is performed with the Chameleon engine enabled.
Unicode conflict resolution utility is consistent across tests unless explicitly overridden.
The test suite expects the same set of input and expected output files for every run.
io_behavior: Reads template source files and expected output files from the test data directory.
Writes template source into in‑memory PageTemplate objects.
Invokes the template objects to produce rendered HTML strings.
Compares the rendered HTML to the expected output and reports mismatches as test failures.
Raises an ExpressionError when a template contains an invalid TAL expression.
Outputs a summary of test results (pass/fail) to the test runner’s standard output.

public_api.class:UnitTestSecurityPolicy: checkPermission(self, permission, object, context);validate(self, accessed=None, container=None, name=None, value=None, context=None, roles=None, *args, **kw)

side_effects: Temporarily installs a stub security policy and a Unicode conflict resolver utility.
Registers a default traversable adapter in the Zope component registry.
Creates in‑memory folder and template objects used during the tests.
Resets the original security policy after the test suite finishes.
May log assertion errors or exception tracebacks via the unittest framework.
Does not modify any external files or persistent system state.

rationale: The program installs a stub security policy and registers adapters, matching side‑effect expectations, but it replaces core utilities with no‑op stubs, reads no real files, and renders templates as empty strings. Only a tiny subset of the required tests are present, and the ExpressionError test will never raise, so most behavioral, I/O, invariant, and edge‑case requirements are unmet.
